questions.prompt: A ransomware email goes around the office, but staff recognize it from last month's training and nobody clicks.
A disk in the file server fails. Its mirror keeps serving files and nobody notices.
Monitoring flags the outage within two minutes, and the runbook has the web servers back in twenty.
With half the servers down, the team shuts off the reporting jobs so checkout has enough capacity.
The office has two internet providers. When one has an outage, traffic moves to the other.
A known exploit for the web server is released, but the server was patched last week.
The only person who knew the backup system is on vacation, so the company calls the vendor's emergency support line.
After an incident, the team measures that the database took 3 hours to restore, and works to get it under 1.
One measure can support more than one R.
